title: What CTOs Should Measure Before Renewing Their AI Coding Tools
description: 90% of organizations using AI tools now pay for AI models. A renewal evidence plan: set a baseline, separate use from value, and budget for usage-based billing.
og_alt: Editorial card reading Before You Renew AI Tools, for a guide on the baseline, evidence and billing questions a CTO should settle before renewing AI coding tools.
